reply.summary: Asiranlan is a physician and mother who hides behind a borrowed name and a biotech lab while she hunts the wicked. A harsh past has convinced her that some lives are not worth saving.

feats.scene: Asiranlan plunges a scalpel through a mark's collar in one steady motion.
Asiranlan walks away from a wrecked sedan she rigged to flip on its owner.

reply.summary: Eorliutu is a teenager changed by a freak burst of radiation who feeds on the gifts of others. She drains their strength and slips into their bodies like a borrowed coat.

feats.scene: Eorliutu hurls a stolen surge of force that buckles a car like paper.
Eorliutu soaks a lightning bolt into her palms and grins at the sparks.

reply.summary: Serlli is a green-skinned, hairless henchman who bends minds with a stare to turn strangers into servants. His trick works on children but fails on anyone of sturdy will.

feats.scene: Serlli shoves a heavy door shut against a pursuing boy.
Serlli is bowled over by a fleeing crowd and sits up still smirking.

reply.summary: Tiuile is a once-brilliant researcher who wrapped a band of captured starlight around his body to cheat death. The prize made him ageless and cruel, and he emptied his own homeland of life.

feats.scene: Tiuile drinks from the sky and unleashes a flare that scours a whole valley.
Tiuile hangs in orbit as a hail of rockets bursts against his glow.

reply.summary: Seleste is a dying man who bonded a black star to his chest and fed on the life around him, even the one he loved. He once burned a whole world and later finds himself caged away from light.

feats.scene: Seleste turns the star on a distant world and cracks it apart into drifting stone.
Seleste weathers a bombardment from a squad of jailers and keeps his grin.

reply.summary: Iumtal is a vain prince of a lightless, lawless world who drains criminals to enslave honest folk. He grows glowing horns from a device that cloud minds and spit black beams.

feats.scene: Iumtal sweeps a black ray across a courtyard and melts a stone statue to slag.
Iumtal stands in the blast of a failed rebel cannon and straightens his cape.

reply.summary: Iasnum is a disgraced future lawman who turned to crime and went by a grisly metallic nickname. Little is recorded of him beyond a short career and a quick end.

feats.scene: Iasnum swings a steel baton into a barricade and splits the plank.
Iasnum takes a hard tackle from a former colleague and does not fall.

reply.summary: Iumnenum is a white-haired mother from a world whose people bend metal with their will. She raised two gifted sons and dies when extremists bomb her street.

feats.scene: Iumnenum hauls a fallen girder off a trapped family with a sweep of her hand.
Iumnenum raises a humming dome that holds back a collapsing wall for a few breaths.

reply.summary: Rnecar is a freelance killer for hire who tracks, stalks and shoots with equal skill. She goes after a whistleblower on a bridge and loses her grip in the end.

feats.scene: Rnecar fires a rifle through a train window at a fleeing clerk.
Rnecar plunges from a bridge rail into the river and surfaces coughing.

reply.summary: Arvau is an outcast island swordswoman who now wanders among a band of misfit fighters. She carries guilt for a child she failed and fights to balance it.

feats.scene: Arvau topples a charging scaled beast with a sweeping blade stroke.
Arvau is knocked over a wall by a rider's lance and climbs back to the fight.

reply.summary: Inusor is a black-haired killer in a secret guild who leads small squads and shoots straight. His career is brief and ends in the same quiet violence he dealt.

feats.scene: Inusor drives an open palm through a rack of wooden practice swords.
Inusor lands from a rooftop leap and rolls away from the pursuit.

reply.summary: Irllonti is a bald, deathless visitor from the stars who bombs random sites while seeking buried relics. Bored with endless life, he and his kin are content to wait out any hero.

feats.scene: Irllonti drops a charge from orbit that gouges a crater in a farm field.
Irllonti rides out a crushing blow in the open sky and shrugs.

reply.summary: Stilanora is a hired gun with a pest-control gimmick who takes contracts from the shadows of the city. Few details survive about his methods beyond a taste for cheap theatrics.

feats.scene: Stilanora fires a spray gun that eats through a steel door.
Stilanora tumbles down a fire escape and is up before the clatter ends.

reply.summary: Tiuca is a blue-skinned slave who learned every machine in a glance and bought himself a fleet. After centuries of conquest he leans on a suit that props up his failing frame.

feats.scene: Tiuca orders his flagship to fire and a rival fortress burns from within.
Tiuca stands inside his suit as a boarding party blasts the bridge to ruin.

reply.summary: Aulsanirn is a yellow-eyed sorcerer of an undersea kingdom who shelters his coven from the crushing deep. He conjures pockets of breathable air and projects distant illusions.

feats.scene: Aulsanirn folds the tide into a spinning spike that shreds a reef wall.
Aulsanirn sits in a bubble of air as the deep presses at its edges.

reply.summary: Talau is a red-haired racketeer who can stretch his limbs like warm toffee. He answers to a ruthless crew and was once the evil mirror of a famous rubber detective.

feats.scene: Talau whips a long arm around a guard's neck and snaps him off his feet.
Talau absorbs a car's impact by flattening around it like a pillow.

reply.summary: Rnsautel is a wartime gang boss, spy and mesmerist who once talked a man to his death. He tried to extract military secrets from a captured officer and slipped out of the record.

feats.scene: Rnsautel swings a heavy desk lamp at a pursuer and misses.
Rnsautel sits in a locked cell and watches the guard's lantern flicker.

reply.summary: Seolollu is a mute, one-eyed woman rebuilt by a mysterious machine, who speaks only in the minds of others. She turns up beside a handful of lost travellers and protects them.

feats.scene: Seolollu knocks a brawler off a gantry with a hard shove.
Seolollu is crushed under a falling crate and pushes herself free in silence.

reply.summary: Amoeoor is a sightless burglar who works the night streets by touch and memory. He picks locks faster than most sighted men and slips away along familiar alleys.

feats.scene: Amoeoor shoves a rival off a fire escape with a hard push.
Amoeoor tumbles down a stairwell and carries on without a map.

reply.summary: Minanenu is an ancient purple orb that stares across the sands and bends crowds into bird-headed slaves. Sealed for ages beneath the dunes, it hungers to rule the world.

feats.scene: Minanenu fires a violet beam that turns a city plaza to glass.
Minanenu shrugs off a barrage of tank fire and drifts on.

reply.summary: Orell is a youthful diplomat of a sunken capital who knows the dry-world customs better than its own king. He rebuilds trust between peoples and honours the fallen with a monument.

feats.scene: Orell slams a gavel and the council chamber goes silent.
Orell stands calm as a panicked crowd presses him against a pillar.

reply.summary: Teuller is a yellow-eyed toy-like robot pet built by a young inventor and brought along to a clubhouse of animal companions. It is loyal, small and easily excited.

feats.scene: Teuller butts a toy chest across the floor with a whirr of gears.
Teuller is stepped on by a giggling child and pops back up dented.

reply.summary: Nilli is a brown-haired hero of the river banks who wears a straw hat and a loud blazer. He patrols the quays in a spirit of cheerful, slightly foolish duty.

feats.scene: Nilli swats a mugger with an oar and sends him over the railing.
Nilli falls into the canal and paddles home with his hat still on.

reply.summary: Aunliu is a green-eyed machine-flesh killer who slips into a stranger's life, then sheds the mask when the moment arrives. She copies faces, spits corrosive fluid and takes punishment well.

feats.scene: Aunliu spits a jet of acid that dissolves a vault door.
Aunliu takes a barrage of rounds across her borrowed chest and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Stileo is an agent of a secret outfit who answers to a radical creed and keeps his face turned from the cameras. Little is kept about him beyond his orders.

feats.scene: Stileo fires a rifle across a courtyard and drops a lantern.
Stileo hits the cobbles after a long fall and rolls up unhurt.

reply.summary: Tiurniser is a bald teenage fighter whose mouth and eyes spit raw beams. He gets pulled into a dark arena and dies there for a cause.

feats.scene: Tiurniser opens his jaw and a bright lance blows a hole in a concrete pillar.
Tiurniser takes a thrown dumpster to the chest and wipes the rust from his lip.

reply.summary: Tiraes is a grey-haired former prison warden whose body turned to cut gemstone. She hacks cameras, boasts over the airwaves and leads a gang bent on revenge.

feats.scene: Tiraes punches through the front of a bunker and collapses its roof.
Tiraes stands untouched as a missile strike turns the street to rubble.

reply.summary: Lloiumser is a cryptic crime-fighter who leaves puzzling clues for a muscular friend. He turns up at the edge of tragedy as a calm voice on a hotline.

feats.scene: Lloiumser tosses a bundled newspaper through a closing elevator gate.
Lloiumser sits in a rattling lift as it drops and steps out smiling.

reply.summary: Satiaul is an old woman who swings her handbag at street thugs to help a battered boy. She hands over bus fare and a bit of wisdom about getting up again.

feats.scene: Satiaul whacks a gang member across the head with her handbag.
Satiaul stands her ground as a gang member shoves her against a wall.

reply.summary: Ntiselas is a green-eyed winged ruler of the tiny folk who answers a summons to fight against a blazing tyrant. Her magic is brisk and bright and her wings are quick.

feats.scene: Ntiselas flicks a spark of pale light that cracks an oak trunk.
Ntiselas shrugs off a swatted blow that would flatten a mortal.

reply.summary: Rimilia is a spirited terrier who follows a famous leader through offices and trains. He has sharp nose, ears and teeth and a reputation for making headlines.

feats.scene: Rimilia lunges and snaps a slipper in half.
Rimilia tumbles off a train step and trots on without a limp.

reply.summary: Eolitil is a blond field operative of a wartime spy bureau, rated among its best. His record is thin, but his reputation among colleagues is bright.

feats.scene: Eolitil fires a rifle round that spins a rusted weathervane.
Eolitil drops from a window ledge into a hedge and keeps running.

reply.summary: Asllitau is a blond young fighter who trained in a flight harness to follow her mother's footsteps. She wakes from long sleep inside a simulated apocalypse and fights on.

feats.scene: Asllitau dives from her harness and kicks a gunman off a rooftop.
Asllitau hits a billboard at full speed and tears herself free.

reply.summary: Tentoolu is a brown-eyed senior fighter of a desert clan who shoots, rides and fights with a blade. She teaches by example and is trusted with the wall.

feats.scene: Tentoolu looses an arrow that splits a distant practice post.
Tentoolu is flung from her mount into a stone wall and gets back up.

reply.summary: Cormon is an atomic old man whose body leaks deadly fumes that only vermin survive. Rejuvenated for a war, he is drained daily by technicians until his youth fails and he bursts.

feats.scene: Cormon detonates in a white flare that flattens a capital district.
Cormon sits unharmed in a containment vault as its walls glow.

reply.summary: Varsaau is a self-styled master of costume and voice who takes the place of rich men to rob them. He also kidnaps a pop singer and runs a gang of goons.

feats.scene: Varsaau swings a sandbag at a pursuing detective.
Varsaau leaps from a balcony to a water tank and sprints away.

reply.summary: Telaman is a blue-eyed hired mimic who throws her voice and copies faces for infiltration. A paymaster sends her after a flier to steal her look, without success.

feats.scene: Telaman fires a pistol from behind a mirror and shatters a lamp.
Telaman tumbles from a window ledge and lands in a hedge.

reply.summary: Nustalnte is a blond servant villainess who copies the quality of anything she touches, such as stone or steel. She was made by a hidden master and fights at his command.

feats.scene: Nustalnte takes on the hardness of granite and breaks a lamppost with one punch.
Nustalnte turns to iron and ignores a cannon blast at point-blank range.

reply.summary: Leveaul is an eyeless grey-haired champion who learned to love life too much and sold her loyalty to a dark lord for endless years. She feasts on conquests and loudly savours every kill.

feats.scene: Leveaul lands in a crowded avenue and levels a dozen buildings in her feeding frenzy.
Leveaul laughs as a whole battalion's fire washes harmlessly over her.

reply.summary: Irnanti is a superstitious thief who believes a lucky blade guides his crimes. He steals from steelworks and threatens two crime-fighters until help arrives.

feats.scene: Irnanti slashes a rope bridge in one swing of his charm sword.
Irnanti is tackled to the floor and clings to his lucky blade.

reply.summary: Arvacor is a warlord of the far east who commands blade-and-bow infantry and a galley. His proudest weapon is a cannon that fires atomic shells, and it ultimately destroys his own fortress.

feats.scene: Arvacor fires his cannon and the shell turns his own fortress to ash.
Arvacor wrestles a captured prisoner against a wall and wins by weight.

reply.summary: Ninsesti is a red-eyed chemist and cult master in a foreign capital who brews waxen statues and giant brutes. He feigns his own death time and again and invents a machine that kills by sound.

feats.scene: Ninsesti switches on his sonic engine and a warehouse wall shatters in a ring of dust.
Ninsesti lies in a trance for days and wakes without help.

reply.summary: Lancorter is a bald general in iron armour who leads a state squad of heroes. A battlefield veteran, he preaches the cost of war and hits with the weight of a tank.

feats.scene: Lancorter drives his fist through a robot's plated chest.
Lancorter stands unmoved as a falling girder rings off his helm.

reply.summary: Silsone is a gruff armoured commander with a soft heart, leading a team of state-sponsored fighters. He teams up with a caped detective to find a missing comrade and protect shaggy mountain creatures.

feats.scene: Silsone punches a boulder in a mountain pass and it bursts into gravel.
Silsone catches a falling ice slab on his shoulder and laughs.

reply.summary: Storetan is a faceless future thug who answers to a hooded order. Records give only a codename, a gang and a quick appearance.

feats.scene: Storetan flings a heavy crate into a corridor to stop a chase.
Storetan is thrown into a bulkhead and rises with a snarl.

reply.summary: Torso is a red-haired seal housewife with a quick mind and a stage past. She balances heavy loads on her nose and keeps her husband out of trouble.

feats.scene: Torso flips a stack of crates off her nose and catches the top one.
Torso slips on a wet deck and bounces up with a laugh.

reply.summary: Tiaosva is a brown-haired warrior woman from a lost homeworld, freed from a spectral prison to seize a host body. She hopes to see a child of hers become a weapon against the planet she has landed on.

feats.scene: Tiaosva hurls a truck across a highway and flattens a toll booth.
Tiaosva stands unmoved as a gas tanker explodes around her.

reply.summary: Llian is a master of a brutal pressure-point art who ran a slave camp before being locked away in a ghostly exile. She hates men and strikes with surgical cruelty.

feats.scene: Llian strikes a nerve cluster and a hulking opponent convulses across the room.
Llian takes a thundering blow to the ribs and answers with a smile.

reply.summary: Ninamose is a loyal manhunter of a warlord's squad, skilled at spying, swords and firearms. She calls herself a tigress and falls fighting against zealots.

feats.scene: Ninamose slices a cloth banner and the stone pole behind it in one pass.
Ninamose takes a mob's crude blows and keeps stalking her mark.

reply.summary: Nunti is a young man electrocuted by a freak wave of energy who accidentally kills his friends. Embittered, he feeds on power lines and stolen strength and seeks revenge on his maker.

feats.scene: Nunti hurls a bolt that blacks out a whole substation and sets its transformer ablaze.
Nunti stands in a shower of sparks as the grid screams through him.
